category_title: Individuals with multiply controlled SIB partially identified in initial assessments
minimal_context: The student is in a padded treatment room with access to moderately preferred toys while the therapist sits nearby reading a magazine.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here are some toys for you to play with. I am going to sit over here and read my magazine now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Wearing a helmet, she ignores the toys and begins hitting and kicking her torso and legs.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops kicking and begins scratching and pinching the skin on her arms.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to have quiet time right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Rapidly escalates to hitting herself in the head and repeatedly banging her head against the surface of the padded treatment room.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here are some toys for you to play with. I am going to sit over here and read my magazine now.

STUDENT: (Wearing a helmet, she ignores the toys and begins hitting and kicking her torso and legs.)

TUTOR: Keep playing with your toys.

STUDENT: (Stops kicking and begins scratching and pinching the skin on her arms.)

TUTOR: We need to have quiet time right now.

STUDENT: (Rapidly escalates to hitting herself in the head and repeatedly banging her head against the surface of the padded treatment room.)
